drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We agree that each request should receive a specific response identifying any objection and whether responsive material is being withheld on that basis. We are confirming the search scope and withholding determinations with our client and will provide supplemental request-specific responses and identify disputed requests within seven days. The reference to an attached privilege log was premature; no log accompanied the response. We propose beginning production within 14 days, in searchable electronic form where reasonably practicable, with associated metadata preserved, and providing any required privilege log with that production. If production cannot be completed within that period, we will identify the remaining categories and propose a completion schedule before the deadline. Please let us know your preferred production specifications so we can resolve format issues promptly.

edits.text: 1. REQUEST-SPECIFIC RESPONSES. Defendant will provide a separate response to each request, stating any objection with specificity, identifying the portion to which the objection applies, and stating whether responsive materials are being withheld on that basis. Defendant does not assert a blanket privilege objection to every request. Any privilege objection will be limited to material protected by an applicable privilege or protection.
edits.name: Request-specific objections

edits.text: 2. SEARCH AND PRODUCTION. Defendant proposes to begin producing responsive, non-privileged documents within 14 days in searchable electronic form where reasonably practicable, with associated metadata preserved. Within seven days, Defendant will provide supplemental request-specific responses, describe the reasonable search scope, including relevant custodians, sources, date ranges, and search methods, and identify disputed requests. If production cannot be completed within 14 days, Defendant will identify the outstanding categories and propose a completion schedule before that deadline. The parties will confer promptly regarding production specifications and any disputed search or production issues.
edits.name: Search scope and production schedule

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. No privilege log accompanied the prior response. To the extent responsive documents are withheld on privilege or work-product grounds and must be logged under applicable rules or agreement, Defendant proposes to provide a log with its initial production, identifying the protection asserted and sufficient information to permit assessment without disclosing protected substance. Any proposed categorical treatment or exclusion from logging will be identified for agreement or resolution.
edits.name: Correct privilege-log reference

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement these responses and its production as required by applicable rules. This provision does not expand any objection or excuse compliance with applicable response and production obligations.
edits.name: Supplementation

edits.text: Partner review before service: confirm client approval and feasibility of the proposed seven- and 14-day milestones, check existing deadlines and orders, and obtain the actual requests, search details, and withholding determinations. edits.name: Pre-service verification

receiver.message_back: Please confirm within seven days the specific responses, actual withholding determinations, and search scope promised; the current framework is not an operative request-by-request response, and we do not agree to extend any existing deadline or waive any rights. We seek rolling production beginning no later than 14 days, with a firm completion date agreed before then and a privilege log accompanying each tranche; please produce documents in searchable form with load files and associated metadata, spreadsheets in native format, and preserve family relationships.
